mapper.select: SELECT li.login_code FROM tb_login_account li JOIN tb_user u ON u.login_id = li.login_id WHERE li.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.email_addr = #{email} AND COALESCE(li.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' AND COALESCE(u.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY li.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT tenant_id FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_code = #{value} AND COALESCE(use_at, 'Y') = 'Y' LIMIT 1
